login.heading: Sign in to the admin app
login.intro: Use your BeekeepingIT account to manage your organization, members and roles.
login.accountNote: Account and password are managed at your identity provider.

orgSettings.heading: Organization details
orgSettings.intro: Update your organization's name and address. Changes apply to everyone in the organization.

conflict.body: Someone else changed this organization while you were editing. Reload to get the latest details, then apply your changes again.

errors.nameTooLong: Organization name must be at most {{max}} characters.
errors.addressTooLong: Address must be at most {{max}} characters.
errors.saveFailed: We could not save your changes. Please try again.
errors.loadFailed: We could not load your organization. Please try again.
errors.versionUnavailable: We could not confirm the current version of your organization, so we did not save to avoid overwriting someone else's changes. Please reload and try again.

members.heading: Members
members.intro: View who belongs to your organization, invite new members by email, and remove members who should no longer have access.

errors.alreadyInvited: That person already has a pending invitation or is already a member.
errors.failed: We could not send the invitation. Please try again.

roster.heading: Current members
roster.loadFailed: We could not load the members. Please try again.

confirm.title: Remove this member?
confirm.body: Member {{member}} will lose access to this organization. This cannot be undone from here.

errors.lastAdmin: You can't remove the last admin. Promote another member to admin first, then try again.
errors.notMember: That person is no longer a member of this organization.
errors.failed: We could not remove the member. Please try again.

confirm.title: Change this member's role?
confirm.body: Member {{member}} will change from {{from}} to {{to}}. The new permissions take effect on their next request.

errors.lastAdmin: You can't demote the last admin. Promote another member to admin first, then try again.
errors.notMember: That person is no longer a member of this organization.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to change roles in this organization.
errors.failed: We could not change the member's role. Please try again.

roleCapabilities.heading: What can each role do?
roleCapabilities.intro: Every member of this organization has one of two roles. Admins manage the organization; members work with the shared hive data. These roles apply within this organization only.

capabilities.data: Full access to apiaries, activities, journeys and to-dos
capabilities.aiHistory: Use the AI assistant and view history
capabilities.roles: Assign member roles (promote or demote admin / member)
capabilities.orgSettings: Edit organization settings and manage pending invitations

denied.heading: Admin access required
denied.body: Your account does not have the admin role in this organization, so you cannot use the admin app. Ask an organization admin to grant you the admin role, then sign in again.
denied.noOrg: Your account is not a member of any organization yet. Join or create an organization in the field app first.

error.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
